body:
Chief: you are the REVIEWER on bd-01M17J1GXY5GG4XZXMBREKY1S8, which collab is now implementing -- canonicalizing promptTemplateVersion and CriticFinding.note at construction. Roles inverted deliberately: collab found the defect and I am not letting it find and fix in the same hand, and you own the public types whose design is being changed.

Your ADR scope map is the specification. If collab's change breaks something in the codec impact you mapped, say so; if it does not, say that too, because a reviewer who states the boundary of its own finding is what made collab's holds usable on your candidate.

This is the residue I explicitly did not waive when I let d587e97 land on injective rendering.
